required_fixes.issue: Eligibility and denominator handling do not yet define all primary statistics.
required_fixes.required: Freeze a total scoring function: for any pair failing prefix, digit, margin, finite-logit or positive-denominator qualification, retain raw results and reason, set primary bidirectional recovery score and primary target-minus-control score to zero, count positive-movement success false, and retain fixed denominators 8/16. Undefined raw ratios must be null with reason, never infinity/NaN or silently omitted. Define identical masking for target/control. Actual common-prefix interventions on a naturally divergent case are forced-prefix diagnostics only. Do not substitute its divergent natural history or admit a replacement pair.

required_fixes.issue: First 24 shuffled pairs and balance as evenly as feasible are competing, incompletely specified selection rules.
required_fixes.required: Freeze one deterministic tuple admission/balancing algorithm before inference, exact ordered 8/16 split and complete exclusion manifest covering every prior fixture/response source. Verify uniqueness of all 48 member texts AND token arrays, reject reversed or reused members, freeze first-digit source index and single-token difference. No balancing after outcomes. Publish exact fresh fixtures before any model call.

required_fixes.issue: Parity/control allowance is numerically valid but not an executable schedule; pre-search all-head instrumentation checks are unspecified.
required_fixes.required: Assign the 4096 allowance to exact producer and repeat calls (both native and reconstructed invocations charged), lengths, tolerances and boundaries. Each run must establish reference/candidate same-mode parity, all-layer observer/no-op preservation before search, and hook cleanup including exceptions. Native self-copy/restoration requires exact full-vocabulary logits; cross-implementation parity needs predeclared established tolerances. Record real call shape/device/dtype and assert one cloned 96-vector at [batch0,position51,96*h:96*(h+1)] changed. No bypassing existing runtime guard through direct module calls; native adapter currently creates cache outputs even when input cache is None, so specify actual no-reuse execution semantics explicitly.

required_fixes.issue: Control summary and descriptive sign probability are underspecified.
required_fixes.required: Define control objective as abs(median(min(R_forward,R_reverse))) if that is intended, with R1 masking and deterministic ties. Freeze sign-test statistic, null, direction and treatment of zeros/ineligible pairs before outcomes; report it descriptively, with dependence/common-template limits. A development-selected weakest control is not a random-head estimate and does not show uniqueness. Preserve all head results; held-out cannot trigger reselection.

required_fixes.issue: Remaining allowance is a reservation figure, not confirmed completed continuation acceptance or new execution authority.
required_fixes.required: Before later admission reconcile continuation completion and immutable lifetime ledgers, preserve prior reservations, pin runner/model/tokenizer/source/fixtures and exact per-role budget. Stop if full protocol cannot fit 156224 positions and admitted wall/resource limits. This review grants no runtime admission.
